findings: AppState initialization creates stores/scanner, starts automatic scheduler and may register launch-at-login after onboarding; it was not instantiated in verification controls.

Automatic organization checks onboarding, user preference and isWorking, scans then analyzes when model is ready. After organizeApproved returns, status unconditionally reports the precomputed candidate count as automatically organized; actual partial/error handling remains in unread method.

totalReclaimableSize adds duplicate, archive and installer totals without deduplicating source paths across workflows, potentially counting an archive/installer also present in duplicate groups twice.

scan itself has no entry isWorking guard and awaits multiple actors while holding a Boolean busy flag; direct overlapping callers can replace shared files/status. Some surrounding entry points do guard, so reachability requires remaining caller review.

Excerpt passed to local evidence is produced by reviewed 4000-character extractor. Analysis identifies files by path IDs rather than array index, avoiding rescan index drift, but content identity still is not bound.

minimumConfidence and archiveDays apply lower bounds only; persisted unusually large values are not upper-bounded here. Profile is reloaded during scans; failure diagnostics depend on previously reviewed store behavior.
